name: United Arab Republic

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and black, with two green five-pointed stars in the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: Red, white and black are the Arab Liberation colours of Egypt's 1952 revolution, and the two stars stood for Egypt and Syria.

hook: The UAR is red-white-black with two green stars, one each for Egypt and Syria; Iraq writes green script there, Egypt today uses a gold eagle, and Yemen leaves the white stripe empty.
trivia: Egypt kept the name United Arab Republic until 1971 and this flag until 1972, a decade after Syria left the union.
Syria readopted the two-star flag in 1980 and used it until the fall of the Assad government in December 2024.
